definitions.gloss: public hall; civic hall; community hall
definitions.explanation: A large public building owned by a city or town, used for assemblies, concerts, lectures, ceremonies, and other community events.

examples.japanese: {公会堂|こうかいどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演奏会|えんそうかい}→演奏会：18026_ensoukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A concert will be held at the public hall.
The city's public hall is near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{公会堂|こうかいどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That old public hall is preserved as a historic building.

notes:
Composed of {公|こう} (public) + {会堂|かいどう} (hall, assembly hall). A municipally owned hall used for community gatherings and events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公会堂|こうかいどう}: a city public hall
- {公会堂|こうかいどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold (an event) at a public hall
- {公会堂|こうかいどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧: to rent a public hall

- ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦{会館|かいかん}→会館：04119_kaikan⟧: civic center — a similar municipal facility; the more common modern name
